I seeded a fresh encrypted mini corpus: scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py --mini (24 articles, default rng) into /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H/data-enc, with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026 and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset. The DB file's first 16 bytes are ciphertext (b'}\xa4\xe2\x11…'), not 'SQLite format 3'. That is the same environment as the first walk. No extra sandbox seed was needed.

Server: launched from the worktree with `python -c "from src.api.main import main; main()"`, OO_PORT=8900, OO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H/data-enc. Airplane mode held throughout. /api/system/network answered online:false after every cancel, 'Go online' was never pressed, and the page recorded 0 non-loopback requests. Fetch mode was the default Transparent (transport kind 'direct'). For the H3 protected-mode check I switched it to Protected with proxy http://127.0.0.1:9 through Settings > Advanced > Safety, then reverted it to Transparent with an empty proxy. Browser: Chromium 1194 headless via Playwright (executable /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, with --disable-background-networking, --disable-component-update and --no-proxy-server). Passes: 1440x950 in en, fr, ar and zh; 375x667 in en, fr and ar; 375x800 in en for O2.

new_defects.title: Home strip says '(server busy)' on an idle, offline server, beside 'Automatic collection: stopped'
new_defects.repro: Boot and unlock. Stay offline and do nothing that writes, and stay on Home for about 90 s. Then read the at-a-glance strip (#home-stats).
new_defects.expected: The note should appear only when the counts are really being held back by a busy server, or it should state their real age without giving a cause. On an idle server nothing was written and the counts are current.
new_defects.actual: Once the cached payload is 90 s old, the strip ends with 'as of 06:23 AM (server busy)', and the same note appears in fr ('serveur occupé'), ar and zh. The status line beside it says 'Automatic collection: stopped'. At the same time the API reports scheduler running:false and online:false, and /api/database/stats shows cache_age_s growing 89→209 with an unchanged as_of. An operator in airplane mode is told the server is busy when nothing is running.
new_defects.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H/probe_busy.json (9 samples: the note appears once cache_age_s ≥ 90, with sched_running False); /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H/shots/H-home-server-busy-en.png; part3.json home_strip_0s in fr, ar and zh. Row S's walker saw the same note under OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1 and left it unjudged; here it reproduces with the scheduler present.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/api/served_cache.py:236-244: when the change probe is unchanged, the value is treated as 'still exactly right'. The code re-stamps checked_at but deliberately keeps built_at, so cache_age_s grows without bound on an idle server. src/static/app-home.js:117-137 (homeStatsAgeNote) labels any cache_age_s ≥ 90 as t('as of {time} (server busy)') and never checks whether a recompute is pending. Either drop the cause from the note or have the payload say whether the value was re-verified.

new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/index.html:3210 oninput="filterDoc()" re-renders the whole prose on every keystroke. src/static/app-settings.js:85 then calls first.scrollIntoView({block:'center', behavior:'smooth'}) each time. walk.summary:
Row H's click-through clause closes on the fixed build 0deff9c4. The encrypted corpus booted locked and was unlocked through #pw, and the app stayed in airplane mode throughout, with 0 non-loopback requests.

The first walk's P1 is fixed. Each lane's host bubble is now hosted inside the modal 'Go online?' popup and is topmost, readable in full, for all 15 lanes in en, fr, zh and ar and at 375 px. Lanes also open their bubble on keyboard focus.

Steps H1-H8 pass. H9 needs the maintainer's word and H10 needs going online, so both are not-measurable-here. Step text now differs from the build in three expected ways:
- Local AI shows n=7 hosts, not 4. Fix batch B12 added github.com, release-assets.githubusercontent.com and ollama.com, and SECURITY.md lists the same 7.
- SECURITY.md reads 'Last checked 2026-09-26'.
- The Local AI transparent-mode sentence is the new 'Mostly not through this app's fetcher…'.

All 8 row-H defects (H1-H8) are fixed. So are the other rows' defects on these surfaces: O5 and P1 (bubbles in modals, including the Export dialog), P2, P6, L5, O2, T4, T7, U4, P7 and U5. The security enumeration, consent and coach tests pass here: 48 pytest and 3 node suites.

New defects:

items.ref: new:Home strip says '(server busy)' on an idle, offline server, beside 'Automatic collection: stopped'
items.evidence: Own instance: a fresh encrypted mini seed at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H-recheck/data-enc (ui_clickthrough_seed.py --mini with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE set; the DB header is ciphertext), booted on 8950 with neither variable set. lock-state read 'locked'; I unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock and stayed on Home doing nothing. My probe (rc_busy.py) sent no stats requests of its own and only recorded Home's own /api/database/stats polls. as_of stayed 09:06:10 while cache_age_s rose 14 -> 119. At dt=150 s the strip ended 'as of 09:06 AM (server busy)' while #home-status said 'Automatic collection: stopped'. At that moment /api/scheduler/status read running:false, active:false, online:false, and its own server_load read loop_lag 0.3 ms, heavy in_flight 0/4, busy_refusals 0, memory_guard engaged:false. /api/system/network read online:false. After live switches: fr 'à 09:06 (serveur occupé)', ar '(الخادم مشغول)', zh '（服务器繁忙）'. Files: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H-recheck/rc_busy.json and shots/rc-home-busy-en-strip.png, rc-home-busy-{en,fr,ar,zh}.png. No page, console or HTTP errors. This is not a harness artifact.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-home.js:117-137. homeStatsAgeNote() tests only payload.cache_age_s >= 90 and always names the cause as '(server busy)'. But src/api/served_cache.py:233-245 is written to keep built_at when the grants probe shows nothing was written: it re-stamps only checked_at, and as_of/cache_age_s are derived from built_at (served_cache.py:152). So on an idle server the value is verified as exactly right, yet cache_age_s grows without limit, and the note fires because the server is idle. The S3.4(d) brief (docs/design/AUTONOMOUS_SESSION_BRIEF_2026-09-02_CRASH_ROOT_CAUSE.md:825) ties the note to a stale-served payload. No ruling covers the idle case: grep of OPEN_QUEUE/RULINGS_INDEX/LESSONS found nothing, and planned.py reports nothing for app-home.js.
items.suggested_fix: In served_cache._decorate, also publish the age since the value was last verified or rebuilt (now - checked_at), or a verified_unchanged flag. Show '(server busy)' only when that verification age is >= 90 s, which means a rebuild is pending or in flight. For a value that was verified unchanged, show nothing, or a cause-free 'unchanged since HH:MM'. Alternatively, gate the cause on /api/scheduler/status server_load. Add a node test for the idle case: cache_age_s 120 with a fresh verification gives no 'server busy'.

The label beside the box is translated (fr 'Autoriser les requêtes de découverte de sujets vers DuckDuckGo', ar 'السماح بإرسال استعلامات اكتشاف المواضيع إلى DuckDuckGo'), and so is the disclosure paragraph (keyed 12/12). items.root_cause: src/static/app-backup.js:3126-3128. saveDiscoveryExternal() writes the two result sentences into #discovery-external-result with textContent and passes the two toast sentences to toast() as bare English literals. None of the four is wrapped in t() or keyed in src/static/locales/*.json. The DOM walker (src/static/i18n.js:34-44) translates only exact keys, so the four stay English, on first paint and after a live switch alike. toast() (src/static/app-core.js:510-512) does not translate.
items.suggested_fix: Add the four strings to all 12 locale files. Pass the toasts through OOI18N.t. For the result line, either write the English key and let the walker translate it on paint and on oo:langchange, or render with t() on an element marked data-i18n-dyn and repaint it on oo:langchange. Do not write a translated string into a walker-owned node, or it gets cached as the English original. Extend the i18n chrome audit so it catches textContent/toast literals like these.

items.ref: new:Help 'Find on this page…': typing a phrase whose first match is in the Security endpoint table highlights it but does not scroll it into view
items.evidence: rc_find.py: each case ran on a fresh page, with Help > Security opened and scrollY set to 0. Typed 'Where in the tree' at 60 ms per key: 1 mark, table scrollLeft 519, page scrollY 125, mark top 1822 in a 950 px viewport (out of view). At 200 ms per key: scrollY 163, mark top 1784. Typed plus Enter, then 8 s: scrollY 125. At 375x667: scrollY 210, mark top 5025, table scrollLeft 962. fill() gives scrollY 1479, mark top 468 (1440), and scrollY 4908, mark top 327 (375). keyboard.insert_text also gives scrollY 1479. Typed prose 'kept true' does jump (scrollY 503, mark top 466). Controls: forcing behavior:'auto' on scrollIntoView still fails (scrollY 111 at 1440, 161 at 375, with the window pulled back in the same frame as each input event). Deferring the unchanged smooth call with setTimeout(0) lands (scrollY 1479, mark top 468). rc_find_ctl.py: after typing, #doc-find sits at top -30 / bottom 14, just brought back into the viewport, the signature of the caret reveal that follows a keystroke. Files: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H-recheck/rc_find.json, rc_find_ctl.json, shots/rc-find-typed60-1440.png, rc-find-filled-1440.png, rc-find-typed60-375.png, rc-find-typed60-DEFER0-1440.png. Playwright's keyboard.type goes through the same editing path as a real keypress, so this is not a harness artifact.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-settings.js:85. highlightProse() calls first.scrollIntoView({block:'center', behavior:'smooth'}) synchronously inside the #doc-find input handler (src/static/index.html:3210 oninput="filterDoc()" -> app-settings.js:66-70). After a real keystroke's input event returns, Chromium reveals the focused input's caret. That reveal overrides or aborts the page-level part of the scroll. When the match sits inside the horizontally scrollable table, the scroll is a two-step sequence (table, then page), and only the table step survives. A paste or fill makes no keystroke caret reveal, and a prose match needs only the page step, which is already animating, so both work.
items.suggested_fix: Move the scroll out of the input event. A setTimeout(0) or requestAnimationFrame is enough (measured). Better, debounce filterDoc by about 150 ms, which also stops re-rendering the whole Help body on every keystroke. Optionally, scroll the table wrapper and the page as two explicit steps.

recheck.summary:
All four of walker H's items reproduce on build 0deff9c4 on my own instance, and I found one new P3 layout defect. Setup: a fresh encrypted --mini seed, booted locked on port 8950 and unlocked through #pw. Airplane mode held throughout (online:false, zero non-loopback requests), no consent was granted, and discovery_external_enabled was put back to false. I stopped my server by PID 11305 and did not touch the other walkers' servers or the worktree (git status clean).

1. '(server busy)' on an idle server: CONFIRMED P2. Home's own polls show the cached stats aging from 14 to 119 s with the same as_of, and the strip then reads 'as of 09:06 AM (server busy)' in en, fr, ar and zh. At that moment the scheduler is stopped, the app is offline, and the server's own load readings show it idle (loop lag 0.3 ms, nothing in flight). Cause: the note in app-home.js:117-137 fires on the value's age alone. But served_cache.py:233-245 deliberately lets that age grow when nothing has been written, so the note appears precisely when the server is idle.

2. Topic-discovery result line and toasts: CONFIRMED P2. The disclosure line and both toasts are English in fr, ar and zh (the line also stays English after a live switch), while the label and paragraph beside them are translated. None of the four strings is keyed in any of the 12 locale files. Cause: app-backup.js:3126-3128 writes them as bare English strings.

3. Help 'Find on this page' typed into the Security table: CONFIRMED P3. Typing 'Where in the tree' highlights the match but leaves the page near scrollY 125 (210 at 375 px). Filling or pasting the same text lands at 1479. A control that runs the same scroll one tick later (setTimeout 0) lands correctly; forcing an instant scroll does not. Cause: app-settings.js:85 scrolls synchronously inside the input handler, and Chromium's caret reveal after the keystroke pulls the page back to the input.

4. Help document list: CONFIRMED P3. In zh, fr and ar only 'User Manual' is translated; the other 9 titles and all 10 descriptions stay English. The list comes from English strings in main.py:2699-2750, and only 'User Manual' is keyed. Q1122 = b keeps the ×12 rule, and S06-05 covers the document bodies, not this list.

New P3: the 'Allow topic-discovery queries' checkbox is stretched to 150-209 px by the global input width:100% rule (app.css:435), which squeezes its label into three narrow lines. I measured this at 1440 px in en and fr only; my 375 px run failed at the sidebar click, so that width is unchecked.

Scripts, JSON and screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/H-recheck/ (the files starting rc_ and shots/).
